description: Production Electricité-Guadeloupe is a dataset listed in KaruData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by L’Observatoire Régional de l’Energie et du Climat (OREC). Quantité d'électricité produite par an (en MWh), détail par type de source d'énergie (pétrole, charbon, eolien, photovoltaïque, etc.). Coverage: Guadeloupe. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are electricite, consommation, OREC. The portal shows 13 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-11-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-karudata-com-portal.
